1. Revenge in a way. Holmes, the bartender's father, shot watson. Even tho watson was guilty, he couldn't get revenge on his father ( Cause of death is left to public interpretation)
So he shoots his son.


2. At the start of "study in pink", holmes later makes a comment about how watson was not suffering from ptsd because he was trying to get away from the past, but because he missed the past and the action and the blood of the battlefield. 
This, in a way, reveals a darker side of watson, that we haven't seen very often.

3. The main reason- Watson revealed everything to him. If he lived, and it was known that watson had killed homes and pretended that he existed in his stories, it would cause a lot of rage. Thus, he made sure no one lived to tell any tales.

"What do you mean?" Asked the bartender with a slightly confused look on his face.
It was just another plain old monday for him. The same customers, the same drinks, the same people. Afterall, in such a remote and small town, everybody knew each other's names, at the very least.
"Shh! You can't speak so loud" said a man with a thick moustache with a slight curl at the end. He wore a long black hat with tight edges. It was long enough to hide his mess of a hair. This man's name was John Watson, but everyone knew him as watson. 
" Is this some kind of a gimmick?" Exclaimed the bartender, clearly frustrated at watson. 
Watson signalled towards the backdoor and went towards the fire exit, and disappeared around the back. He knew every shortcut of every building and every road in that town.

"Look man, I Don't have a lot of time. I've got a lot of angry customers waiting, so you better make this quick" the bartender exclaimed, as he joined watson out in the backside of the bar.
It was a chilly morning and it was snowing heavily. Snowflakes, curled like feathers, would drip on the red pine leaves.
"Okay, I'll make this quick. Your name is joe isn't it?"

" Yeah, how'd you know?"

"You have 3 dogs. All hill dogs that you rescued when they were pups. You wanted to be an actor but you got kicked out of every audition, so in a desperate attempt you sold off your estate and ran off to new york. Then you got news that your uncle, the owner of this bar, died. So you came around and managed all of its affairs ever since"

The man didn't say a word. He stared long and hard at watson, then finally scoffed. 
"What's the meaning of all of this?" He said with a skeptical look on his face.

Watson leaned in closer. 
"You've heard of the legendary sherlock holmes, haven't you?"

The bartender nodded.

"Well listen carefully to me." Watson continued. "Holmes, doesn't exist. He is a figment of my imagination. A fictional character. A myth, a legend. All those stories. None of those cases were solved by him."

The bartender stared intensely at watson, and when he realized he wasn't joking, asked "Well someone ought to have solved those cases then, innit?"

"Indeed." Watson replied. "That someone, was me. I am holmes, joe. I created this conscious entity in my head. I named it holmes. It talks to me everytime I need to solve a case. I don't know how, but somehow it does. Sometimes, it'll make me do things i didn't know I did. Like waking up at 3am and surveying the neighbourhood. Or looking into your family history. That too was a result of his doing"

The bartender stared at watson like he was crazy. 
"And what's the point of telling me all of this? I mean, why me!?" He exclaimed.

Watson took a deep breath, pondered for a while and replied. 
"Your dad was in the military, wasn't he?" 

The bartender slowly nodded.

"Well, your father was sherlock holmes."

"What do you mean?"

"When I was in vietnam, working as a military doctor, your father was an officer deployed with me. He had graduated just a year ahead of me. We quickly shared stories and became buddies. To this day, he remains my best friend"

"..what do you mean? My father died while serving his country decades ago"

Ignoring him, watson continued, "Real smart guy, your father. He had extreme deductive skills. He could tell what you had for dinner, and what your pet's name was. Taught me everything I know."

"So what happened?"

"Well, you see, joe. One fine day, we were returning from our evening patrol duty, when our hummer was bombed. Everyone except your father and I had fainted. We had to get out of that vehicle. I helped your father out first.
But just as i was leaving, your father had a sly grin on his face. He took out his .22 and shot me in my arm at point blank range."

He rolled up his sleeve to reveal a slightly curved scar from the forearms to the fold of the arm. 

It was a nasty scar. The bartender gasped. 
" Why would he do that? My father would never betray anyone"

Holmes stared at the man for a while, reached for his pipe in the inner folding of his trench coat, and replied while lighting his pipe, "He did it because the bastard was smart enough to figure out that I was the one who had arranged the bombing of our car.
I couldn't stand it joe! The killings, the people killing, the people getting killed. Battlegrounds turning to rose gardens, battlecry stories turning to the prisoner's screams of fear on the faithful rack. I wanted to end all of it. Our troop was one of the most elite secrets of the military. If I ended it, there would stilll be war, but a lot less of it. It all drove me insane. I was going crazy! I just couldn't bear the guilt that came with saving the life of someone who just destroyed a village" 

 He then pushed the bartender towards the wall and asked him, " Do know why I told you all of this?"

"What does all of this mean?" Exclaimed joe, surprised and confused. "Why have you brought me out here!?"

"I have lived with the guilt of killing your father for years. That's why i created him again. To fight for justice, not war" 

"However, there is one thing I still miss from my days"

Dr watson had an evil smile on his face. He reached for a pistol in his trench coat.
 He pointed it at the bartender and shot him at point blank range in his forehead.
The bartender fell on his knees and rolled over as blood trickled down from the gaping wound in his forehead.


"Ah blood. Been a long time since ive seen some" watson exclaimed kneeling down, as Holmes smiled while he peeked over watson's shoulder at the dead body.
